description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is this Part?
This is the Emergency Brake Lever HANDLE
Connects to your Brake Lever
Pre-Cut Hole for Brake Release Button
Direct Replacement
Note: Requires Heating Before Installing to Avoid Splitting Handle
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Handle, Emergency Brake Lever
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
